scope: G034 immutable source-title captions on live calibration plots and retained snapshots

implementation.capture: Source title is captured in the same immutable retained payload as plot data and annotations. Manual calibration and explicit plots use captured source metadata; fitted publication uses prepared preview metadata before commit. No source lookup in rendering or retained document/provider added.
implementation.presentation: Shared renderer displays Source: captured title, with (untitled source) for an empty title. Report/Editor.plot_snapshots_info exposes exact source_title. Unicode and literal ###/% text remain title content, separate from stable window IDs. CSV sample format is unchanged.
implementation.memory: Title string capacity is charged once with the shared payload before metadata commit/publication. Snapshots share it; source rename/closure cannot alter it. This is managed retained-memory accounting, not total RSS or transient/driver allocation measurement.

verification.api: All three plot publication routes preserve Unicode/ID-like/format-like title text. Rename invalidates live plot while snapshot keeps original title through source close. A1MiB source title under a1MiB render budget refuses before calibration/history commit and preserves prior snapshot/managed bytes.
verification.actual_imgui_input: Existing dedicated C++ and Python lifecycle case now uses Unicode source title, then fixture rename and closure. Readers verify captured captions along with existing actual Keep/Duplicate/axes-after-close/CSV/close input and lifetime/memory invariants.
verification.native: Windows projection and private viewport/annotation/payload consumers pass. Linux C++17 private payload consumer passes against existing pinned SDK archive; no Linux UI/full SDK promotion.
verification.limits: Focused headless and installed checks; no independent empty-caption visual, OS/GPU, full-family or comparative-performance acceptance.

storage.retention: All owned terminal compiler/consumer scratch retired. Necessary logs/producer freeze/captures compressed and member-hash verified. One active cache/runtime/SDK per platform, no whole cache/checkout archive. Historical scopes/fingerprints unchanged.

remaining: On-canvas annotation placement/style and image export
Nice/minor ticks and generic histogram/profile renderer reuse
Snapshot/session persistence and independent OS-window backend/OS/GPU qualification
Broader calibration/settings/import/replay/downstream and Linux UI/macOS/IO SDK/original-reference gates
